description: The search functionality on the homepage is not working properly. When I type a query, it returns no results even when valid content exists.
Please add a dark mode option for the entire website. It would be much easier on the eyes during night browsing.
The knowledge base could benefit from better search filters. I want to filter by tags and type more easily.
Great documentation! I was able to set up the entire repository in under 30 minutes thanks to the getting started guide.
response: Thank you for the kind words! We're glad the documentation helped you get started quickly. If you have any other questions, feel free to reach out.

description: The metrics dashboard is not loading on mobile devices. The charts are cut off on smaller screens.
It would be great to have a notification system for new blog posts. Currently, I have to check manually.
response: That's a great idea. We're currently working on a newsletter feature that will be released in the next update. Stay tuned!

description: Could you add a tutorial video showing how to use the tool inventory? Text documentation is sometimes hard to follow.
When trying to access the feedback form, I get a 500 error. Please check the feedback.html page.
Please add an export feature for the knowledge base so users can download their search results or filtered data.
The site loading speed could be improved. Some pages take 3-4 seconds to load on my connection.
response: We've been working on performance optimization. The most recent updates should have improved load times. Thanks for your patience!
